item.title: Postoperative Analgesia in Dermatologic Surgery Shows Low Adverse Events
item.description: Perioperative liposomal bupivacaine injections showed minimal adverse events in 129 dermatologic surgery patients in a new review. The post Postoperative Analgesia in Dermatologic Surgery Shows Low Adverse Events appeared first on European Medical Journal.

item.title: Lightweight Neural Networks Improve Lung Cancer Diagnosis
item.description: A comparative study shows that lightweight convolutional neural networks can accurately classify lung cancer histopathology with strong generalisation and reduced computational complexity. The post Lightweight Neural Networks Improve Lung Cancer Diagnosis appeared first on European Medical Journal.

item.title: Brain Connectivity Changes in Chronic Fatigue Syndrome
item.description: New imaging evidence shows altered brain networks during cognitive effort in chronic fatigue syndrome and long COVID patients. The post Brain Connectivity Changes in Chronic Fatigue Syndrome appeared first on European Medical Journal.

item.title: Mycophenolate Matches Methotrexate in Juvenile Localised Scleroderma
item.description: A cohort study shows mycophenolate mofetil and methotrexate reduce disease activity in juvenile localised scleroderma, with fewer adverse effects seen with MMF. The post Mycophenolate Matches Methotrexate in Juvenile Localised Scleroderma appeared first on European Medical Journal.

item.title: Cast Immobilisation for Unstable Ankle Fractures
item.description: Cast immobilisation proved non-inferior to surgery for the treatment of unimalleolar Weber B ankle fractures with a congruent mortise on initial radiography but deemed unstable by external rotation stress testing. The post Cast Immobilisation for Unstable Ankle Fractures appeared first on European Medical Journal.

item.title: DMT Outperforms Standard Antidepressant
item.description: A single intraperitoneal dose of DMT (30 mg/kg) administered after UCMS exposure reversed depressive-like behaviours and restored cognitive performance, outperforming chronic fluoxetine treatment. The post DMT Outperforms Standard Antidepressant appeared first on European Medical Journal.

item.title: IVF Clinic Networks Accelerate Digital Investment to Boost Efficiency
item.description: Fertility clinic networks are increasing investment in predictive analytics and digital systems to improve cycle throughput and financial performance. The post IVF Clinic Networks Accelerate Digital Investment to Boost Efficiency appeared first on European Medical Journal.

item.title: Emerging Virus Threats: Influenza D and Canine Coronavirus
item.description: Influenza D and canine coronavirus HuPn-2018 could fuel future respiratory epidemics amid diagnostic and surveillance gaps, experts warn. The post Emerging Virus Threats: Influenza D and Canine Coronavirus appeared first on European Medical Journal.

item.description: With two new Nipah virus cases confirmed, the pressure is mounting on the pharmaceutical industry to manufacture a vaccine. The post Nipah in West Bengal: a pharma call to action appeared first on European Medical Journal.
